sources.entry: Pomodoro Cycle - Pomodoro Cycle for macOS

summary.one_liner: A macOS desktop Pomodoro timer app that tracks work intervals and sends desktop notifications, built with Electron.
summary.what_it_does: The app runs focus sessions based on the Pomodoro Technique, which splits work into timed intervals (traditionally 25 minutes) separated by short breaks. It tracks pomodoro intervals and sends desktop notifications when intervals change. Users can adjust interval settings. The README lists a macOS download at version 0.0.6 and provides developer instructions for running the app in development and building a macOS package with npm scripts.
use_cases: track focused work sessions on a Mac
get desktop alerts when a work interval ends
build a macOS Electron app from source
notable: Implements the Pomodoro Technique with configurable interval settings
Packaged as a macOS app with a published download link
caveats: Targets macOS only, according to the README's platform table
README is brief and does not document settings or detailed usage
Developer setup depends on npm and Electron tooling
